status: exploratory, adapted after the image and partial BSG spectra
method: Nine-point finite-difference Newton search for a stationary trace, with three decreasing parameter stencils and explicit convergence, trust-region and Hessian gates. Qualify every evaluated primitive orbit. Retain native float64 monodromies at phases 0,6,12. At least one phase must pass the unchanged 1e-7 composed-JVP and 1e-6 eigen-residual gates; the leading pair across all phases must agree within 1e-5 of its largest modulus. Verify composed finite differences at the final endpoint. No default point on any failure.
interpretation: Inspect trace, determinant, Hessian signs, stencil sensitivity and numerical uncertainty. A nonzero trace saddle supports locally separated trace-zero arcs; a near-zero value alone does not certify an exact crossing. Negative nonzero determinant implies two opposite-sign nonzero multipliers and excludes double-zero superstability for the tracked pair at that point.
resources: One owned secure A100 SXM80GB, eight threads. Measured dense period-18 cells take about23 seconds; allow30 seconds plus cyclic-phase checks, with60-minute internal limit and bounded partial retrieval. Shell75 minutes, setup/run95 minutes, hard120-minute lifetime including20-minute retrieval reserve. Exact ownership watchdog and verified shutdown. Cost: see private ledger.
